title: Blood clot

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Blood clot is an item and can be dropped from Ticks in the Mistlands biome.

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text:
• Staff of protection
• Mead base: Major healing
• Uncooked magically stuffed shroom

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Blood clots can be farmed by finding and aggroing a Gjall, preferably in a relatively flat and open area of terrain to afford the player room to maneuver, and keeping it alive: it will continue to occasionally spawn ticks in groups of three, which can be killed for Blood clots. This will require avoiding and/or blocking the Gjall's projectile attacks while waiting for it to spawn more ticks.

full_text:
Blood clot

Type: Material | Internal ID: GiantBloodSack | Source: Ticks | Usage: Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

Introduction. Blood clot is an item and can be dropped from Ticks in the Mistlands biome.

Crafting. • Staff of protection
• Mead base: Major healing
• Uncooked magically stuffed shroom

Notes. • Blood clots can be farmed by finding and aggroing a Gjall, preferably in a relatively flat and open area of terrain to afford the player room to maneuver, and keeping it alive: it will continue to occasionally spawn ticks in groups of three, which can be killed for Blood clots. This will require avoiding and/or blocking the Gjall's projectile attacks while waiting for it to spawn more ticks.
